hypothesis: US equities earn a positive return around scheduled FOMC announcements because investors are compensated for macro-policy event risk.

rule.entry: market-on-close of the immediately preceding available NYSE session
rule.exit: market-on-close of the scheduled regular FOMC statement session

limitations: Daily data tests close-to-close FOMC exposure, not the narrower intraday pre-14:00 academic window.
MOC fills require later broker-specific parity and slippage evidence.
Raw SPY prices omit distributions, conservatively biasing an ex-dividend event downward.
